description: Published spatial-intelligence benchmark scores across VLMs, compiled 2026-10-25 from leaderboards and paper tables. No model was run. Every value was read from the cited source (machine-parsed from arXiv HTML / leaderboard JSON). Benchmark keys are "<benchmark>|<evaluator>"; values from different evaluators for the same benchmark are NOT interchangeable. Keys prefixed "control:" are general-ability controls. When two rows of one source map to the same canonical model, the first is kept and the other is listed under "conflicts".
